channel.title: Noty
channel.description: Sticky notes that live at the edge of your screen.

item.description:
Set tab labels in the note hand, narrow the tabs, and stop clipping titles

- Tab labels now use the same face as note bodies, a weight bolder
(Noteworthy Bold, 9.5pt), and follow the handwriting setting.
- Tabs narrowed from 36 to 30pt.
- Titles no longer clip: the strip was being sized to exactly the measured label
width, so rounding ate the last glyph. The strip is now the label plus 20pt
and the label is drawn inside it with a 12pt inset, leaving real slack. The
measurement also has to use the face the tab actually draws with.
- The label is centred on the visible tab rather than on the bled shape, which
was pushing it toward the screen edge.
